description: This Java class 'FineractInitializer' is part of a testing framework for the Apache Fineract project. It manages initialization steps for different testing scenarios, including global, suite, and scenario-specific setups, and logs the initialization activities.

classes.name: FineractInitializer
classes.description: A class responsible for initializing various components of the Fineract test environment, managing global, suite, and scenario initialization steps.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Lifecycle method invoked after bean properties are set; logs initialized steps if debug is enabled.

methods.name: setupGlobalDefaults
methods.description: Executes all global initializer steps and sets the business date to today.

methods.name: setupDefaultsForSuite
methods.description: Executes suite-specific initializer steps and updates the business date.

methods.name: setupDefaultsForScenario
methods.description: Executes scenario-specific initializer steps and updates the business date.

methods.name: resetDefaultsAfterSuite
methods.description: Resets suite-specific initialization states and resets the business date.
